title: Edity Limits vocabulary meta-schema
description: The keywords of the Limits vocabulary and the values they take. The x-edity- prefix belongs to this vocabulary, so a keyword with that prefix that is not listed here makes the schema invalid.

x-edity-maxGraphemes.description: Assertion on strings: at most this many extended grapheme clusters (Unicode UAX #29).

x-edity-decimals.description: Assertion on numbers: the shortest decimal form of the value, as an IEEE 754 double, has at most this many fraction digits.

x-edity-maxLines.description: Annotation: at most this many rendered lines. The Editor measures them; validators accept any value.

x-edity-maxLinesNarrow.description: Annotation: at most this many rendered lines on narrow screens. The Editor measures them; validators accept any value.
